data.action: 立于灯塔石栏边手提黄铜风灯，微风拂动斗篷
data.animaCaption: Standing on the stone balcony of a coastal lighthouse at dusk, she holds a glowing brass lantern in her midnight-blue velvet cloak as evening breezes stir her blonde hair.
data.camera: 中景，平视，海天晚霞背景
data.description: 落日沉入海平线的古老石砌灯塔观景台上，菲比披着深蓝天鹅绒金扣连帽斗篷，双手提着暖光黄铜风灯望向归航船影。
data.lighting: 暮色晚霞紫橙渐变与风灯暖光
data.location: 拉古那外海古石灯塔观景台
data.promptProse: High on the stone gallery of a seaside lighthouse as twilight deepens over the waves, Phoebe wraps herself in a midnight-blue velvet cloak fastened with a gold sun clasp, holding a warm brass lantern.
data.title: 菲比 · 暮色灯塔观景台手提黄铜风灯
